Need execution too? Add an HFT engine on your own infrastructure, colocated with the venues — you run the strategies, we keep the connectivity current. See models ↓ Data Shop Pay as you go €1 / instrument-day One instrument, one trading day, € 1 — the complete tick file. No subscription, no minimum. Browse the archive, add days to cart, download after checkout — invoice included. Every individual update is stored — reconstruct order books and resample at any interval. Ideal for spot checks, backtest samples and filling gaps in your own capture. Need 1-minute statistics instead of ticks? The rolling 24h CSV (22 columns — OHLCV, VWAP, trades, spread, depth) is free on every instrument page; Premium extends it to 7 days and any recorded day. Day bundles at the same price: every contract of a Kalshi or Polymarket series, or a whole Deribit option chain, for one UTC day — from €1 flat per bundle-day. Browse the data shop Browse day bundles Free samples & docs Add-on Premium membership & credit packs €20 / month 50 download credits a month (1 credit = one instrument-day) plus the deep analytics tier across the whole site — monthly billing, cancel anytime. Credit packs for historical data, any tier, never expire: €100 → 140 credits · €250 → 375 credits · €1,000 → 1,750 credits (up to 75 % extra). Get Premium — €20 /month All features → Buy credit packs Realtime Realtime market data The full protocol is documented in the market-data and trading-API docs . Self-serve · by the day Realtime access €49 / instrument · day €99 / market · day Longer runs, lower per-day price Buy consecutive UTC days in one order — the length of the run sets the per-day price for every day in it. Consecutive days Per instrument · day Per market · day 1–⁠13 days €49 — configure 1 day per instrument €99 — configure 1 day of a whole market 14–⁠29 days €45 — configure 14 days per instrument €90 — configure 14 days of a whole market 30–⁠179 days €40 — configure 30 days per instrument €80 — configure 30 days of a whole market 180–⁠364 days €35 — configure 180 days per instrument €70 — configure 180 days of a whole market 365+ days €30 — configure 365 days per instrument €60 — configure 365 days of a whole market Billing Per UTC calendar day, one day or thirty — checkout in the shop, invoice included; extend any time from your account. Paid by card; credits apply to historical data only. Markets Binance USDT-M , Binance Spot , Coinbase Spot , Kalshi , Polymarket , OKX and Bybit — a single instrument or the whole market (every instrument of the venue) ; Kalshi and Polymarket are sold as whole markets only . See low-latency Binance market data for the Binance endpoints, or real-time crypto market data for every venue, its lines and what each feed carries. Endpoints London , Frankfurt , Ashburn , Ohio and Tokyo are the self-serve locations today; more will follow . At source At source means the normalized feed is handed over at the site where the venue is captured — no dedicated line, so there is no line latency to quote. Every market is also sold where it is captured, at €35 per instrument-day or €69 per market-day ; longer runs there cost €32 / €28 / €25 / €21 per instrument-day and €63 / €56 / €49 / €42 per market-day from 14 / 30 / 180 / 365 days . Order entry Not included — market data only. History Not included — recorded days are €1 each in the shop. Protocol WebSocket in JSON or SBE — see the connection guide . Talk to us about API access P aid days start at the next 00:00 UTC and the rest of the purchase day is included free . Captured at each venue and delivered at our London, Frankfurt, Ashburn, Ohio or Tokyo endpoints over dedicated lines (Binance, OKX and Bybit from Tokyo at London, Frankfurt, Ashburn or Ohio; Coinbase from Ashburn at Ohio or Tokyo; Kalshi from Ohio at Tokyo; Polymarket from London at Tokyo), and at source where the venue is captured (Binance, OKX and Bybit at Tokyo; Coinbase at Ashburn; Kalshi at Ohio; Polymarket at London) — over a dedicated line, that line is what the per-day price pays for; at source, the normalized feed at the venue's site . London, Frankfurt, Ashburn, Ohio and Tokyo are the self-serve locations today; more will follow , and enterprise subscriptions already cover further locations and venues . Only the enterprise feeds and the SDK involve a conversation first — what the enterprise products include → Free sample days Buy one day for € 1 Enterprise & SDK: write to us Why CryptoStruct Why CryptoStruct Four things every page on this site is built on — and the reason the numbers above exist at all. We record everything The complete public feed of each venue as it was published: every Level-2 snapshot and update, every trade with its aggressor side, every quote, funding, mark-price and liquidation event — for every instrument the venue lists, every UTC day since we added the venue. Where a venue offers more than one order-book feed, we take the one with the lowest latency, at the depth that feed carries. Nothing sampled, no on-demand capture. Institutional grade Captured co-located at the venue with the exchange timestamp and our receive timestamp in integer nanoseconds, an event-id chain that makes any gap visible, and one normalized schema across 35+ venues — the same capture our own high-frequency trading engine and enterprise feeds run on. €1 per instrument-day Any instrument-day is €1, series-day bundles start at €1 — no subscription, no minimum order, no tiers to unlock. Credit packs lower the effective price and never expire, and free full-day samples from the major venues let you test first. Self-service for everyone Pick the days in the Data Shop , pay by card as a guest and download immediately — no sales call, no enterprise contract, no KYC. Coding agents buy the same files through the MCP server , and the free Agent Skill teaches them the format. Agents: /llms.txt · MCP server /mcp · every page as markdown via Accept: text/markdown FAQ Pricing — FAQ How much does historical crypto tick data cost? €1 per instrument-day — one instrument (or every contract of a prediction series) for one UTC day with tick-by-tick trades, Level-2 order-book depth and 1-minute OHLCV, invoice on checkout, no minimum. Credit packs and the Premium membership bring the per-day price down for larger purchases. Is there a subscription for bulk historical data? No bulk archive subscription is needed: buy exactly the instrument-days you use in the shop, add credit packs (they never expire), or take Premium for monthly credits plus deeper analytics. Everything on this page is self-service; only dedicated enterprise deliveries are priced per setup. What does realtime access cost? Self-serve realtime access is priced per UTC day and market or instrument (see the realtime card), enterprise API subscriptions per API and month, and the strategy SDK as a monthly licence after a free first month. Analyze. Connect. Trade. CryptoStruct records the complete feed of 35+ venues — every message, every instrument, every day — co-located and nanosecond-stamped at institutional grade, and sells it self-service from €1 per instrument-day: buy as a guest, download instantly, no sales call.
